Based on the original 1977 Boss OD1 circuit employing a single chip RC3403 quad op amp and asymmetric soft clipping diodes, this overdrive was the boss of them all back in the day Predating the Tube Screamer by a couple of years this was the first mass market soft diode clipping overdrive pedal and originals are now virtually unobtainable by rarity and price We put a lot of time into sourcing the right quad op amp with ground sensing inputs to produce this simple but oh so powerful overdrive pedal.
